card.name: Subject after did, before a bare verb
card.fires_on: The subject or word right after past-tense "did" or "'d" in questions and negations, where a plain verb comes next ("did they all need", "How'd it taste"). It also fires on a few other spots where a verb is expected soon.

modes.label: Question after did
modes.description: Subject of a past-tense question starting with did or how'd, just before the bare verb.
modes.example: And why did<< they>> all need to be female?

modes.label: Subject of did-question
modes.description: Noun phrase or pronoun after "did" in a how or why question.
modes.example: How did<< he>> do it? Dr. Melis,

modes.label: Negation after did
modes.description: Word after did in a statement, where a bare verb follows.
modes.example: therefore He did<< not>> have to be created.

card.writes: It pushes toward future "will" forms and away from past forms like would, got, began and became.
card.plain: It marks the spot after "did" and its subject where the next word should be a plain verb.
